title: 2023 Panini Select - Premier Black & Green Prizm Die-Cut Clark Phillips III (RC)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Panini Select trading card featuring Clark Phillips III of the Atlanta Falcons. It is a Premier Black & Green Prizm Die-Cut card from the Rookie set, with card number 109. The card is a parallel/variety with a unique design and is manufactured by Panini as part of their sports trading card collection.
